name: aave-markets-data
description: Fetch Aave market data using TypeScript SDK

scripts.ci: npm ci && npm run build && npm run prune && cd backend && npm ci && npm run build && npm run prune && npm run test
scripts.ci:remote: npm run ci && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high 2>&1 | grep -v 'GHSA-848j-6mx2-7j84' | (grep -qE 'found [1-9][0-9]* vulnerabilit|found [1-9] vulnerabilit' && exit 1 || exit 0) && npm --prefix backend audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate 2>&1 | grep -v 'GHSA-848j-6mx2-7j84' | (grep -qE 'found [1-9][0-9]* vulnerabilit|found [1-9] vulnerabilit' && exit 1 || exit 0)
scripts.ci:auto-fix: npm audit fix --omit=dev || true && npm --prefix backend audit fix --omit=dev || true
scripts.prune: ts-prune -i '.*aave-shared-config/index\.d\.ts' 2>&1 | (grep -v '(used in module)' | grep -q . && exit 1 || exit 0)
